service: CloudWatch Omni is a unified observability experience built on Amazon CloudWatch. You work in a space, an isolated environment that holds your telemetry and controls who can access it, and your data is stored in the CloudWatch Dataset for correlated analysis of logs, metrics, and traces.

operations.CreateAccessGrant:
Creates an AccessGrant that authorizes a principal to perform a set of actions on resources in a space.

Optionally narrow the grant with scoped actions that limit it to specific resources and fields. Use ListAccessGrants and GetAccessGrant to retrieve grants, and DeleteAccessGrant to remove them.
operations.CreateAccessProfile:
Creates an access profile in a space.

Use GetAccessProfile and ListAccessProfiles to retrieve profiles, and UpdateAccessProfile to modify one.
operations.CreateAlert:
Creates a new alert within a space.

Use GetAlert and ListAlerts to retrieve alerts, UpdateAlert to modify one, and DeleteAlert to remove it.
operations.CreateDomain:
Creates a domain with identity provider configuration.

Use GetDomain to retrieve the domain, UpdateDomain to change its configuration, and CreateSpace to add spaces within it.
operations.CreateDomainAccessGrantForOrganization: Creates an AccessGrant that authorizes a principal to administer an organization domain.
operations.CreateDomainForOrganization: Creates an organization-scoped domain for the caller's AWS Organization. Only the organization's management account can call this operation.
operations.CreateIntegration: Creates an integration with a third-party provider. Returns the integration identifier and its initial status; when the provider requires interactive consent, an authorization URL is returned for the user to complete setup.
operations.CreateOmniDashboard:
Creates a new dashboard within a space.

Use GetOmniDashboard and ListOmniDashboards to retrieve dashboards, UpdateOmniDashboard to modify one, and DeleteOmniDashboard to remove it.
operations.CreateOneTimeDeepLinkCode:
Generates a one-time code for deep-link authentication.

Direct the user's browser to the returned deepLinkUrl before it expires. The code is exchanged for an authenticated, domain-scoped session and can be used only once.
operations.CreateSpace:
Creates a space in a domain.

Use GetSpace to retrieve the space, ListSpaces to enumerate spaces, UpdateSpace to modify it, and DeleteSpace to remove it.
operations.CreateView:
Creates a new SQL view.

A view is a named, reusable SQL query that can be referenced from telemetry queries. View names must be unique within the account and region. Only USER views can be created — MANAGED views are provisioned by AWS.
operations.DeleteAccessGrant:
Removes an existing AccessGrant, revoking the access it granted.

A service-managed grant cannot be deleted.
operations.DeleteAccessProfile:
Removes an access profile.

An access profile cannot be deleted while access grants reference it.
operations.DeleteAlert:
Deletes an alert by its identifier.

Idempotent: deleting an alert that has already been removed succeeds without error.
operations.DeleteDomain:
Removes a domain and all of its resources. Call this operation in the Region where the domain was created.

A domain cannot be deleted while it contains spaces.
operations.DeleteDomainAccessGrantForOrganization:
Removes an existing organization access grant, revoking the access it granted.

A service-managed grant cannot be deleted.
operations.DeleteDomainForOrganization:
Removes an organization domain and all of its resources. Call this operation in the Region where the domain was created.

A domain cannot be deleted while it contains spaces.
operations.DeleteIntegration: Deletes an integration. Returns the resulting status.
operations.DeleteSpace: Removes a space and all of its resources.
operations.DeleteView:
Deletes the specified view.

Queries that reference the view fail after it is deleted. Managed views cannot be deleted.
operations.GetAccessGrant: Retrieves the full detail of a single AccessGrant by ID.
operations.GetAccessProfile:
Retrieves an access profile by ID.

The response indicates whether the calling principal is currently allowed to assume the profile.
operations.GetAlert:
Retrieves a single alert by its identifier.

Use ListAlerts to enumerate alerts in the space.
operations.GetContextGraph:
Queries the context graph with filtering, traversal, and pagination support.

Pagination note: nodes and edges are returned together as a coherent subgraph. Pagination cursors advance over nodes (the primary collection); each page includes all edges connecting nodes within that page. Callers should treat nodes as the paginated collection and edges as supplementary relationship data attached to those nodes.
operations.GetDomain: Retrieves the details of a domain by ID.
operations.GetDomainAccessGrantForOrganization: Retrieves the full detail of a single organization access grant by ID.
operations.GetDomainForOrganization: Retrieves the details of an organization domain by ID.
operations.GetIntegration: Returns the details of a single integration, identified by its identifier, Amazon Resource Name, or name.
operations.GetIntelligenceConfiguration: Retrieves the intelligence configuration for the calling account. Account is identified via FAS (caller identity). Returns the default configuration if none exists yet.
operations.GetOmniDashboard: Retrieves a dashboard by ID within a space.
operations.GetSpace: Retrieves the details of a space by ID.
operations.GetSpaceCredentialsForOrganization:
Returns temporary credentials for a space in an organization member account. The credentials are valid for one hour.

The caller must be the organization's management account or a delegated administrator with access to the target space. The target account must be an active member of the same organization as the domain, and the space must already exist.
operations.GetTelemetryQueryResults: Returns the results for the specified query.
operations.GetView: Returns the definition and metadata of the specified view.
operations.ListAccessGrants: Returns AccessGrants, with optional filtering by domain, space, principal, or permission. A grant is returned only when it matches every filter supplied. With no filters, returns the grants for the current account and Region.
operations.ListAccessProfiles: Returns the access profiles in a space.
operations.ListAlerts:
Lists alerts within a space, optionally filtered by exact name(s), a single name prefix, or exact alertId(s), with pagination.

Use GetAlert to retrieve a single alert's full detail.
operations.ListDomainAccessGrantsForOrganization: Returns organization-level domain access grants, with optional filtering by domain, principal, or permission. A grant is returned only when it matches every filter supplied. With no filters, returns the grants for the caller's organization.
operations.ListDomains: Returns the caller's domains: the account-scoped domain and the organization-scoped domain, if either exists. At most two domains are returned.
operations.ListIntegrations: Lists the integrations in the account, optionally filtered by type, status, or name. Results are paginated.
operations.ListOmniDashboards: Returns the dashboards in a space, optionally filtered by name prefix.
operations.ListSpaces: Returns the spaces in the account, optionally filtered by domain.
operations.ListSpacesForOrganization: Returns the spaces across all member accounts in the organization.
operations.ListTelemetryFields:
Lists fields available for telemetry queries.

Returns a list of fields included in the specified dataset, granular to telemetry type. Returned field names reflect the exact stored casing and are case-sensitive when referenced in query expressions; the query engine does not normalize identifier case.
operations.ListTelemetryQuerySessions:
Lists telemetry query sessions.

Returns a list of telemetry query sessions owned by the caller.
operations.ListViews:
Lists the views in the caller's account and region.

Returns a summary for each view, optionally filtered by view type. View definitions are not included — use GetView to retrieve them.
operations.PutIntelligenceConfiguration: Creates or updates the intelligence configuration for the calling account. Account is identified via FAS (caller identity).
operations.SearchPrincipals:
Searches Identity Center for users and groups in a domain. The domain must be configured with Identity Center.

To grant access to a result, pass its principalId to CreateAccessGrant with a principalType of IDC_USER for a user or IDC_GROUP for a group.
operations.StartTelemetryQuery:
Starts a telemetry query within a session.

Submits the provided query string for execution in the specified session. Use GetTelemetryQueryResults to poll for results and check query status.
operations.StartTelemetryQuerySession:
Starts a new telemetry query session.

A session provides a logical grouping for one or more telemetry queries. The returned session ID is required when starting queries via StartTelemetryQuery.
operations.StopTelemetryQuerySession:
Stops a telemetry query session.

Terminates the specified session. After a session is stopped it cannot be reused.
operations.UpdateAccessProfile:
Updates the name or description of an access profile.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged.
operations.UpdateAlert:
Updates an existing alert.

Only non-null fields overwrite existing values.
operations.UpdateDomain:
Updates a domain's name or identity provider configuration.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged. Renaming a domain also changes the endpoint URLs derived from its name.
operations.UpdateDomainForOrganization:
Updates an organization domain's name or identity provider configuration. Call this operation in the Region where the domain was created.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged. Renaming a domain also changes the endpoint URLs derived from its name.
operations.UpdateIntegration: Updates an existing integration, identified by its id, ARN, or name. Only the fields you provide are changed.
operations.UpdateOmniDashboard:
Updates an existing dashboard within a space.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged.
operations.UpdateSpace:
Updates a space.

Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged.
operations.UpdateView:
Updates an existing view's definition and/or description.

Only the fields you provide are changed. Managed views cannot be updated.

Alert.base: Full alert entity, returned by both CreateAlert and GetAlert. A create and a read of the same alert describe it identically except for {@code state}, which only the read paths populate. UpdateAlert returns an empty response.

refs.CreateAlertOutput$alert:
The alert that was created. The same Alert shape GetAlert returns, so a caller need not read the alert back to learn its timestamps or its minted alert id.

{@code alert.state} is absent here — see the state member of Alert. Every other member is populated exactly as GetAlert populates it.

AlertCondition.base:
The condition that determines when the alert fires.

On UpdateAlert a supplied condition is replaced whole, not merged: an omitted {@code warningThreshold} or {@code criticalThreshold} removes that tier, and an omitted {@code thresholdField} clears it. A condition must keep at least one tier. {@code thresholdMode} and {@code comparator} are optional at the Smithy level (so a single-tier condition is expressible) but are required whenever a threshold is present; enforced by the service-side validator.

refs.TelemetryRule$condition: The condition that determines when the alert fires.

refs.AlertCondition$thresholdField: The field the threshold is evaluated against.

AlertEvaluation.base:
Evaluation cadence. {@code intervalSeconds} must be one of {30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 900, 1800, 3600}; {@code pendingDurationSeconds} and {@code recoveryDurationSeconds} must be multiples of {@code intervalSeconds}. A duration of 0 means fire/clear immediately with no delay.

On UpdateAlert a supplied evaluation block is replaced whole, not merged: an omitted {@code pendingDurationSeconds} or {@code recoveryDurationSeconds} is cleared to unset (no such duration), not preserved and not defaulted to 0. {@code intervalSeconds} is required whenever the block is present. All enforced server-side / by the front-door validator.

AlertFilterCriteria.base: Filter criteria for ListAlerts. All members are optional; each omitted member is unconstrained. At most one of {@code names}, {@code namePrefix}, {@code ids} may be provided (mutually exclusive; the service rejects more than one). The remaining members combine with AND.

refs.ListAlertsInput$filterCriteria: Filter criteria narrowing which alerts are returned. All members are optional; the three name/id filters are mutually exclusive.

refs.AlertFilterCriteria$namePrefix: Filter to alerts whose name starts with this prefix. Mutually exclusive with {@code names} and {@code ids}.

AlertId.base:
The stable alert identifier: a 32-character lowercase hex uuid, minted by the backend on create and immutable across updates.

It deliberately carries no name, so that a future rename cannot change an alert's identity and break the ARNs, saved links and IAM policies pointing at it. Use {@code name} to display an alert and {@code alertId} to address one.

refs.Alert$alertId: The stable alert identifier (see {@link AlertId}), minted on create and immutable across updates. Use it (not {@code name}) to address the alert on GetAlert/UpdateAlert/DeleteAlert; it is also the ARN's resource id.
refs.AlertSummary$alertId: The stable alert identifier (see {@link Alert#alertId}). Use it to address the alert; it is also the ARN's resource id.

AlertIdFilterList.base: Exact alertId match list. Members reuse the {@link AlertId} type so the charset/cap stay in sync with it.

refs.AlertFilterCriteria$ids: Filter to alerts whose {@link AlertId} exactly matches any entry (OR semantics). Mutually exclusive with {@code names} and {@code namePrefix}.

AlertNameFilterList.base: List of exact alert names to filter by.

refs.AlertFilterCriteria$names: Filter to alerts whose name exactly matches any entry (OR semantics). Mutually exclusive with {@code namePrefix} and {@code ids}.

AlertRuleQuery.base: Query expression and the language it's written in.

AlertSortField.base: Field by which alerts can be sorted.

refs.ListAlertsInput$sortOrder: The order in which to sort results.

AlertState.base: Flat alert state. Severity is folded in: a WARNING/CRITICAL alert reports that state directly. {@code NODATA} indicates the evaluation produced no data (subject to the rule's noData.treatAs handling).

refs.NoData$treatAs: The state to report when an evaluation produces no data.

refs.AlertStateInfo$data: Structured detail about why the alert is in its current state.

refs.Alert$state:
Live evaluation state (read-only, system-managed). Populated by GetAlert. ListAlerts reports state on AlertSummary instead, where it stays required.

Absent on CreateAlert: a newly created alert has never been evaluated, so any state reported there would be a default rather than an observation. Call GetAlert for live state. Not @required for that reason — GetAlert always populates it.

contributorSummary is nested inside this member, so it too is absent on CreateAlert.

refs.NotificationTrigger$stateValues: Alert state(s) that trigger this rule. Empty / omitted = any state.

LogMetadata.base: One LOGS query selector block on a node. The attributes map's keys are AND'd; each selects with col = value. Deliberately RAW/un-normalized so the selector matches the store, not the node's merged identity.

LogMetadataAttributeMap.base: One LOGS query-selector block: EXACT store column -> raw SCALAR value (mirroring the scalar MetadataAttributeMap). Keyed by the store column that carries the value (e.g. resource.attributes['service.name'], attributes['aws.local.service'], @logGroupName) so the selector matches the emitted signal. A dimension seen under several values (a service under two namespaces, several log groups) becomes several blocks with the same columns and different values, which the console ORs. Dedicated to the LOGS selector so its cap evolves independently of the metric attribute map and the TRACES map. Selector caps are deliberately DISTINCT from the metric caps.

LogMetadataList.base: Per-node log query selectors; the list ORs across blocks (e.g. an OTLP block vs a CloudWatch- VENDED block). Bound is a payload cap, not a selection rule.

refs.Metadata$logs: Per-signal LOGS query selectors: a LIST of blocks the console ORs, each an AND of exact store column -> raw values. Node-level (edges carry only traces). Populated when the request sets includeMetadata; derived labels (logSourceType) are added by the service projection, not stored here.

MetadataAttributeMap.base: Per-metric qualifying attributes carried on MetricMetadata. A dedicated shape (not the shared IntelligenceAttributeMap) so its length cap can be tuned independently.

These are the RAW, store-matching values keyed by their OTel names ("service.name", "service.namespace", "cloud.provider", "cloud.account.id", "cloud.region", "instrumentation_scope") — deliberately NOT the node's normalized/merged identity, so the query selectors match the emitted series. A merged node can carry different values per metric, which is why they live here rather than on the node.

When more are observed than the cap, the backend keeps RED/OTel-semconv names (http/rpc server+client, span-metrics) ahead of the alphabetical remainder, so the metrics the console charts survive. refs.EdgeProperties$httpMethod: The HTTP method observed on the request.
refs.Field$name: The name of the field. Field names are case-sensitive and must be used exactly as returned when referencing them in query expressions.
refs.GetTelemetryQueryResultsRequest$nextToke: A token to retrieve the next page of results.
refs.GetTelemetryQueryResultsResponse$nextTok: A token to retrieve the next page of results, or null if there are no more results.
refs.GetViewResponse$definition: The SQL query that defines the view.
refs.Integration$credentialArn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the secret that stores the integration's credentials.
refs.Integration$roleArn: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role that CloudWatch assumes to access the external system.
refs.Integration$authorizationUrl: The URL the customer visits to authorize the integration. Present while an OAuth authorization is pending.
refs.Integration$errorMessage: A human-readable description of why the integration is in an ERROR or FAILED state. Present only when the integration has failed.
refs.IntegrationIdentifier$integrationName: The name of the integration; unique within the account.
refs.InternalServerException$errorCode: The error code associated with the internal error.
refs.ListIntegrationsInput$name: Returns only the integration with this exact name.
refs.ListIntegrationsInput$nextToken: Pagination token from a previous response; omit for the first page.
refs.ListIntegrationsOutput$nextToken: Pagination token for the next page; absent when there are no more results.
refs.ListTelemetryFieldsRequest$nextToken: A token to retrieve the next page of results. Reserved for future pagination; the service does not paginate at this time and returns null.
refs.ListTelemetryFieldsResponse$nextToken: A token to retrieve the next page of results, or null if there are no more results.
refs.ListTelemetryQuerySessionsRequest$nextTo: A token to retrieve the next page of results.
refs.ListTelemetryQuerySessionsResponse$nextT: A token to retrieve the next page of results, or null if there are no more results.
refs.ListViewsRequest$nextToken: A token to retrieve the next page of results.
refs.ListViewsResponse$nextToken: A token to retrieve the next page of results, or null if there are no more results.
refs.MetricMetadata$name: The metric name as emitted, such as "Duration".
refs.MetricMetadata$namespace: DEPRECATED: read attributes["service.namespace"] instead. Retained (deprecated) for backward compatibility with existing consumers; will be removed once they migrate. The logical service grouping the metric belongs to.
refs.MetricMetadata$preferredStat: The statistic to chart or alarm on, such as "p99" or "Sum". Free-form and frequently absent.
refs.MetricMetadata$metricType: OTel metric kind: "gauge", "sum", "histogram", "exponential_histogram", or "summary" (CloudWatch-vended metrics carry the same kinds). Absent when the producer did not report one.
refs.MetricSemantics$description: Human-readable description of what the metric measures.
refs.MetricSemantics$unit: The unit the metric is reported in.
refs.NodeProperties$region: The region the node runs in. Falls back to the region the telemetry was ingested from when the node does not report one.
refs.NodeProperties$cloudProvider: The cloud provider hosting the node, resolved from the reported provider, platform, or vendor namespace, and defaulting to "aws".
refs.NodeProperties$sourceAccountId: The account that produced the telemetry this node was discovered from.
refs.NodeProperties$namespace: The logical service grouping the node belongs to. This is not a metric namespace.
refs.NodeProperties$stage: The node's deployment environment. A node may be observed in several; this is the highest-precedence one. Match any of them with NodeFilters.stage.
refs.NodeSemantics$language: The primary programming language the service is written in.
refs.NodeSemantics$framework: The application framework the service is built on.
refs.NodeSemantics$kind: The kind of workload the service is.
refs.NodeSemantics$repository: The source repository the service is built from.
refs.OAuthClientCredential$clientId: The OAuth 2.0 client identifier registered with the external system.
refs.OAuthClientCredential$providerId: The identifier of the OAuth provider that issued the client credentials.
refs.OrganizationDomain$domainEndpointUrl: The HTTPS endpoint URL for accessing the organization domain.
refs.OrganizationDomain$organizationId: The ID of the AWS Organization that owns the domain.
refs.OrganizationDomain$region: The Region where this organization domain was created.
refs.PrincipalSearchResult$userName: The user name of the principal. Present for users only.
refs.ResourceNotFoundException$resourceType: The type of the resource that could not be found. Not always present.
refs.ResourceNotFoundException$resourceId: The identifier of the resource that could not be found. Not always present.
refs.ResourceNotFoundException$errorCode: The error code associated with the failure.
refs.Space$region: The region where this space was created.
refs.SpaceSummary$region: The region where this space was created.
refs.UpdateIntegrationInput$roleArn: The Amazon Resource Name of the IAM role assumed to access the integration.
refs.UpdateViewResponse$definition: The SQL query that defines the view.
refs.ValidationException$errorCode: The error code associated with the validation failure.

refs.Domain$customEndpointUrls: Additional endpoint URLs derived from the domain name.
refs.OrganizationDomain$customEndpointUrls: Additional endpoint URLs derived from the domain name.

refs.Integration$integrationAttributes: Provider-specific key/value attributes that configure the integration.
refs.UpdateIntegrationInput$integrationAttrib: The provider-specific attributes to associate with the integration.

refs.EdgeFilters$operations: Match edges carrying any of these operations.
refs.Node$alternateNames: Other names this node was observed under. A node that merged across sources reports one resolved name, and the names it was merged away from appear here.
refs.NodeFilters$region: Match nodes in any of these regions.
refs.NodeFilters$cloudProvider: Match nodes on any of these cloud providers.
refs.NodeFilters$sourceAccountId: Match nodes discovered from telemetry produced by any of these accounts.
refs.NodeFilters$namespace: Match nodes in any of these logical service groupings.
refs.NodeFilters$stage: Match nodes observed in any of these deployment environments.

TagKey.base: Tag key. Must be non-empty; AWS-standard maximum length. Constraining the key (rather than a bare String) rejects empty-key payloads at the edge with a 400 ValidationException instead of faulting downstream as a 500.

refs.CreateAccessGrantInput$tags: The tags to associate with the access grant.
refs.CreateAccessProfileInput$tags: The tags to associate with the access profile.
refs.CreateAlertInput$tags: The tags to associate with the alert.
refs.CreateDomainAccessGrantForOrganizationIn: The tags to associate with the access grant.
refs.CreateDomainForOrganizationInput$tags: The tags to associate with the domain.
refs.CreateDomainInput$tags: The tags to associate with the domain.
refs.CreateIntegrationInput$tags: Tags to apply to the integration at creation time (Tagris tag-on-create).
refs.CreateOmniDashboardInput$tags: The tags to associate with the dashboard.
refs.CreateSpaceInput$tags: The tags to associate with the space.

TagValue.base: Tag value. AWS-standard maximum length; may be empty.

TelemetryRule.base: Telemetry-based rule: what to query, how to evaluate the result, what condition makes it fire, and what to do on missing data.

refs.ListTelemetryFieldsRequest$telemetryType: The type of telemetry to filter fields by.

ThresholdMode.base: How a threshold is applied to query results.

refs.AlertCondition$thresholdMode: How the threshold is applied to query results.

ThrottlingException.base: The request was throttled due to exceeding the allowed request rate.

refs.AccessGrant$updatedAt: The timestamp when the grant was last updated.
refs.AccessProfile$createdAt: The timestamp when the access profile was created.
refs.AccessProfile$updatedAt: The timestamp when the access profile was last updated.
refs.Alert$createdAt: The timestamp when the alert was created.
refs.Alert$updatedAt: The timestamp when the alert was last updated.
refs.AlertStateInfo$transitionedAt: When the alert transitioned to its current state.
refs.AlertSummary$createdAt: The timestamp when the alert was created.
refs.AlertSummary$updatedAt: The timestamp when the alert was last updated.
refs.CreateViewResponse$createdAt: The timestamp when the view was created.
refs.CreateViewResponse$updatedAt: The timestamp when the view was last updated.
refs.Domain$createdAt: The timestamp when the domain was created.
refs.Domain$updatedAt: The timestamp when the domain was last updated.
refs.DomainSummary$createdAt: The timestamp when the domain was created.
refs.DomainSummary$updatedAt: The timestamp when the domain was last updated.
refs.Edge$firstObservedAt: When this edge was first observed (UTC), at minute granularity. For an edge that merged across sources, this is the earliest value any source reported.
refs.Edge$lastObservedAt: When this edge was most recently observed (UTC), at minute granularity. For an edge that merged across sources, this is the latest value any source reported.
refs.GetViewResponse$createdAt: The timestamp when the view was created.
refs.GetViewResponse$updatedAt: The timestamp when the view was last updated.
refs.Integration$createdAt: The time at which the integration was created.
refs.Integration$updatedAt: The time at which the integration was last updated.
refs.ListTelemetryFieldsRequest$startTime: Inclusive start of the lookback window. When omitted, the service defaults to the configured lookback before endTime.
refs.ListTelemetryFieldsRequest$endTime: Inclusive end of the lookback window. When omitted, the service defaults to the current time.
refs.Node$firstObservedAt: When this node was first observed (UTC), at minute granularity. For a node that merged across sources, this is the earliest value any source reported.
refs.Node$lastObservedAt: When this node was most recently observed (UTC), at minute granularity. For a node that merged across sources, this is the latest value any source reported.
refs.OmniDashboard$createdAt: The timestamp when the dashboard was created.
refs.OmniDashboard$updatedAt: The timestamp when the dashboard was last updated.
refs.OmniDashboardSummary$createdAt: The timestamp when the dashboard was created.
refs.OmniDashboardSummary$updatedAt: The timestamp when the dashboard was last updated.
refs.OrganizationAccessGrant$createdAt: The timestamp when the grant was created.
refs.OrganizationAccessGrant$updatedAt: The timestamp when the grant was last updated.
refs.OrganizationAccessGrantSummary$createdAt: The timestamp when the access grant was created.
refs.OrganizationAccessGrantSummary$updatedAt: The timestamp when the access grant was last updated.
refs.OrganizationDomain$createdAt: The timestamp when the organization domain was created.
refs.OrganizationDomain$updatedAt: The timestamp when the organization domain was last updated.
refs.SessionSummary$createdAt: The timestamp when the session was created.
refs.SessionSummary$lastActivityAt: The timestamp of the most recent activity in the session.
refs.Space$createdAt: The timestamp when the space was created.
refs.Space$updatedAt: The timestamp when the space was last updated.
refs.SpaceSummary$createdAt: The timestamp when the space was created.
refs.SpaceSummary$updatedAt: The timestamp when the space was last updated.
refs.UpdateViewResponse$createdAt: The timestamp when the view was created.
refs.UpdateViewResponse$updatedAt: The timestamp when the view was last updated.
refs.ViewSummary$createdAt: The timestamp when the view was created.
refs.ViewSummary$updatedAt: The timestamp when the view was last updated.

TraceMetadata.base: One TRACES query selector block on a node/edge (see LogMetadata).

TraceMetadataAttributeMap.base: TRACES counterpart of LogMetadataAttributeMap — a dedicated per-signal map so the two evolve independently (same scalar shape and cap today).

TraceMetadataList.base: Per-node/per-edge trace query selectors; the list ORs across blocks. Bound is a payload cap.

refs.Metadata$traces: Per-signal TRACES query selectors (same block shape as logs). Present on both node and edge metadata. serviceName is derived at the service projection, not stored here.

refs.UpdateAccessProfileInput$description: A new description of the access profile. Omit to leave unchanged.

refs.UpdateAlertInput$description: A new description of the alert. Omit to leave unchanged.

refs.UpdateAlertInput$name: A new display name for the alert. Omit to leave the name unchanged (apply-if-present / PATCH). Same constraints as CreateAlert.name; the name is not the alert's identity, so a rename never changes the alertId.

refs.UpdateDomainForOrganizationInput$name: A new name for the organization domain. Omit to leave unchanged. Must be 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

refs.UpdateDomainInput$name: A new name for the domain. Omit to leave unchanged. Must be 3-63 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

UpdateIntegrationInput.base: The request for updating an existing integration.

refs.UpdateOmniDashboardInput$body: The new dashboard definition, as a JSON document. Maximum 1 MiB. Omit to leave unchanged.

refs.UpdateOmniDashboardInput$description: A new description of the dashboard. Omit to leave unchanged.

refs.UpdateOmniDashboardInput$name: A new name for the dashboard. Omit to leave unchanged.

refs.UpdateSpaceInput$name: A new name for the space. Omit to leave unchanged. Must be 3-64 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. It must begin and end with a letter or number and cannot contain consecutive hyphens.

refs.CreateViewRequest$definition: The SQL query that defines the view.
refs.UpdateViewRequest$definition: The new SQL query that defines the view. Omit to leave unchanged.

refs.UpdateViewRequest$description: The new description of the view. Omit to leave unchanged.

ViewName.base: User view name: must start with "view." prefix followed by lowercase alphanumeric, hyphens, and underscores.

refs.CreateViewRequest$name: The name of the view. Must begin with the "view." prefix. View names must be unique within the account and region.
refs.DeleteViewRequest$name: The name of the view to delete.
refs.UpdateViewRequest$name: The name of the view to update.

ViewSummary.base: Summary information about a view. Does not include the view definition.

refs.ListViewsRequest$type: Return only views of this ownership category.
